questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: If 20g of reactants react completely in a sealed container, what is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products must have the same total mass as the reactants: 20g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a reaction absorbs heat and feels cold?
